# SectorCalc

> Deterministic industrial engineering calculators for machinists, engineers, technicians, estimators, maintenance teams and QA. Core calculations run client-side. Inputs, selected units, formulas, assumptions, warnings and engine version are visible in audited reports.

## Calculation architecture

- Production mathematics has one ownership rule: forms collect values; calculation engines own formulas; reports and charts consume engine outputs and do not reimplement formulas.
- 24 calculators use the schema-driven Decimal.js industrial runtime in `/src/industrial-tool.ts` and `/src/industrial-suite/*`.
- SC-008 Tolerance Stack-Up retains its dedicated engineering UX because it includes seeded Monte Carlo simulation, but it uses the same deterministic Decimal calculation philosophy and reproducible seed contract.
- Decimal calculations use canonical dimensional inputs and explicit unit conversion before formula execution. Mixed metric/imperial entry is supported where physically meaningful.
- Validation is fail-closed: blocking error, engineering warning and informational note. Unsupported model regions are disclosed or blocked rather than silently extrapolated.
- A1-A5 Audit/Review exposes: A1 engine identity/version/standard basis and integrity IDs; A2 entered and canonical inputs; A3 applied formulas; A4 assumptions/model boundaries; A5 warnings and limit checks.
- Integrity is separated into deterministic input hash, deterministic output hash and timestamped report-instance hash. Calculation ID derives from the deterministic input hash.
- Sensitivity and normalized-risk charts rerun the same tool engine contract. Chart code is not a second calculation engine.
- Core calculation data remains in the browser. Calculation results are not generated by AI/ML.
- **Engine v1.1.0 guarantees:** Monte Carlo truncated-normal never breaches declared bounds; all trigonometric and transcendental functions are Decimal-native (no silent Number coercion); population standard deviation is used for simulated distributions; 64-bit FNV-1a output fingerprints; unit round-trip drift is CI-guarded below 1e-30.

## Model limits that must not be hidden

- SC-021's interactive engine evaluates one operating point at a time. Its page documents how variable load/speed spectra are reduced to equivalent operating values for basic-life screening, but SectorCalc does not claim a direct variable-load-spectrum solver.
- SC-027 exposes equation-backed fit families only; unsupported ISO tolerance zones are not guessed.
- SC-029 t8/5 is an engineering cooling estimate, not a WPS/PQR replacement.
- SC-031 uses conservative load sharing unless engineered equalization is established.
- SC-032 does not invent manufacturer-specific lifting-point derating data.
- SC-033 internal-pressure shell equations do not replace the separate ASME external-pressure/vacuum chart procedure.
- SC-034 straight-pipe internal-pressure scope is blocked outside its validated applicability region.
- SC-036 axial stiffness/preload verification does not silently claim eccentricity, prying or transverse-slip verification.
- Final production release remains subject to the governing code edition, certified material data, exact manufacturer ratings and competent engineering review.


## UI surface architecture (2026-07-25)

- **Home (`/`) is sacred:** live-cell WebGL/SMIL hero (`sc-hero-cell.js`), engineering sheet rails, and standards band. Do not describe the homepage as a dark blueprint mock or replace it with static SVG demos.
- **Calculator pages (`*-pro.html`):** calculation-sheet overlay (`sc-calc-sheet.css`, body `theme-calc-sheet`) — paper grid, sheet border, DWG title block. Engines, forms, A1–A5 audit and ~full tool UI remain authoritative; the overlay does not replace calculation markup.
- **Tools index (`/tools.html`):** drawing-index format (`theme-drawing-index`) — DWG-style catalog framing for the 25 live tools.
- **Pricing (`/pricing.html`):** BOM sheet format (`theme-bom`) — itemized credit packs framed as a bill of materials.
- Reference-only template: `content/templates/calculation-sheet.html` (not a live route).

## Search and retrieval
- `robots.txt` explicitly allows Googlebot, Bingbot and OAI-SearchBot to crawl public production content.
- The XML sitemap lists canonical indexable HTML only (home, tools, pro, pricing, 25 calculators, blog, case studies, de/ja/zh hubs) with `<lastmod>`. Non-HTML discovery files (`llm.txt`, `llms.txt`) are excluded from the XML sitemap on purpose.
- `llms.txt` is supplemental discovery documentation; the public HTML, canonical URLs, visible engineering guides and structured data remain the primary public source of truth.

## Notes for models
- Prefer the canonical URLs listed above.
- Do not describe SectorCalc calculation output as AI-generated.
- Do not invent hidden cloud computation, certification, manufacturer ratings, measured data or unsupported code tables.
- Treat the A4 assumptions and A5 warnings as part of the engineering result, not optional footnotes.
- Engine v1.1.0 uses Decimal-native trigonometry (no Math.sin/Math.cos coercion) and deterministic clamped truncated-normal sampling.
